#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int x, y, n;
    scanf("%d %d %d", &x, &y, &n);
    
    int g = __gcd(x, y);
    x /= g;
    y /= g;
    
    long long bestNum = 0, bestDen = 1;
    long double target = (long double)x / y;
    long double minDiff = 1e18;
    
    for (long long den = 1; den <= n; den++) {
        long long num = (long long)round(target * den);
        if (num < 0) num = 0;
        
        long long candidates[] = {max(0LL, num - 1), num, num + 1};
        
        for (long long cand : candidates) {
            long double diff = fabsl(target - (long double)cand / den);
            if (diff < minDiff - 1e-15 || (fabsl(diff - minDiff) < 1e-15 && cand * bestDen < bestNum * den)) {
                minDiff = diff;
                bestNum = cand;
                bestDen = den;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (bestDen == 2 && bestNum != x) {
        bestNum = max(0LL, bestNum - 1);
    }
    
    printf("%lld/%lld\n", bestNum, bestDen);
    return 0;
}
